eligibility: Must be eligible for Sage CU membership: per the official rebrand announcement, the charter covers Klamath, Lake, Harney, and Malheur counties in OR; Modoc and Siskiyou counties in CA; and Humboldt, Pershing, Lander, and Eureka counties in NV (live/work/worship per aggregator summaries — confirm with the credit union). Must open a new Simple, Rewards, Compass, or Pathfinder Checking account by 11/30/2026 and receive a direct deposit of at least $500 within the first 90 days. Excludes anyone who was the primary owner of a qualifying Sage checking account on 08/31/26. Limit one bonus per member; $5 minimum in Membership Savings.
notes: REJECT is a verifiability verdict, not a legitimacy flag: Sage is a real credit union running a real new-checking promotion (9/1/2026–11/30/2026), but the strict checklist requires a concrete payout in official terms and none exists — the official pages were loaded in full on both official domains (mypcfcu.org and sagecu.org) and no dollar amount appears anywhere in the text. Aggregators (doctorofcredit, moneysmylife) quote the same official terms and report the bonus as $250, which contradicts the route's claimed $300 — but aggregator figures cannot be used for the verdict. Do not list this route as verified until Sage publishes the bonus amount in its official terms. If the amount is later confirmed officially, the route amount ($300) will also need correcting.

steps: Go to https://www.mypcfcu.org/checking/ (or https://sagecu.org/) and confirm you are eligible for membership (OR: Klamath, Lake, Harney, Malheur; CA: Modoc, Siskiyou; NV: Humboldt, Pershing, Lander, Eureka).
Open a new Sage Simple, Rewards, Compass, or Pathfinder Checking account by 11/30/2026 (must not have been a primary owner of a qualifying Sage checking account on 08/31/26).
Maintain at least $5 in a Membership Savings account.
Receive a direct deposit of at least $500 within the first 90 days of account opening.
Keep the account open and in good standing; the bonus is deposited at month-end after the account has been open 90 days.
NOTE: the official terms state no bonus dollar amount — do not promise users $300 (aggregators unofficially report $250).
timing: The bonus funds will be deposited to the new checking account at the month end after the new checking account has been open for 90 days, if all requirements are met and the account is open and in good standing.
